bayts.text: The blessing of an Everlasting One Who has been for me with what is pure, upon the father of aṭ-Ṭāhir, light of creation,
upon his Family and his Companions, without end, with a peace that draws what is desired.
The two purest greetings of the Lord of creatures, the most beneficial, upon the Prophet of lofty heights, whose intercession is accepted,
upon his Family and his Companions, just as the Lord of Beauty through him erased my harm, and it vanished.
Bless and grant peace, O Exalted (Ar-Rafīʿ), upon him whose name is Shafīʿ (the Intercessor),
the Family and the Companions; and make all of me worship of You, without weariness.
And bless and grant peace, O Giver of security (Al-Muʾmin), upon him whose name is Muhaymin (the Vigilant Guardian),
his Family and his Companions, the notables, O You Who protected me from the harm of the times.
Bless the Ṣāliḥ (the Righteous), who is the Muṣliḥ (the Reformer), the Ṣādiq (the Truthful), the Truth, with a blessing that sets right,
with peace, and upon all the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O You Who lead to me (a gift) that shames almsgiving, bless and grant peace upon the Muṣaddaq (the Believed),
his Family and his Companions, O You Who restrain: You have restrained the tongues of my enemies and (their) hands.
Bless and grant peace, O God of the worlds, upon the Prophet, master of all the messengers,
the Family and the Companions; and grant me gratitude, O You Who spared me enemies and cunning.
O You Who boast of me before the noble who ascend, bless the Māḥī (the Effacer), imām of the God-fearing,
his Family and his Companions, and grant peace; and with You make me the joy of the learned.
O Everlasting Who leads adornment to me, bless with peace Yāsīn,
his Family and his Companions; and lead to me the wonders of the Everlasting, good pleasure, and be bountiful to me.
Bless him who led my kinsfolk to me, the leader of those with radiant brows and limbs (from ablution),
and grant him peace with the Family and with his Companions, O You Who guard my flanks.
Bless and grant peace, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), upon Your intimate friend and upon those who did not lie,
of his Family and his Companions; and remember me before the noble, and through them gladden me.
The blessing of the Lord of the mighty Throne, the Benign (Al-Barr), upon a dutiful intercessor among creatures,
with His peace, and upon his Family together with his Companions, just as he gathered the distinctions.
The two purest greetings of Him Who bestows gifts with kindness, upon the Prophet, the best of creation, the dutiful,
upon his Family and his Companions, just as (He) took away my harm and granted me my joy.
Bless the Wajīh (the Eminent) and the Naṣīḥ (the Sincere Counsellor), and grant peace, O You Who send down the eloquent (Book),
his Family and his Companions; and grant me to be the beloved of the righteous who were before me.
Bless the Nāṣiḥ (the Counsellor) and the Wakīl (the Guardian), and grant peace, O Giver of reliance.
his Family and his Companions; and preserve through me a wise Remembrance (the Qurʾān) from You, which has become my beloved.
Bless him whose name is Kafīl (the Guarantor) and Mutawakkil (the Reliant), to whom belongs the bonus gift,
the Family and the Companions, with peace; and be for me through Your religion, Islam.
Bless and grant peace, O best Companion, upon one brought near whose name is Shafīq (the Tender-hearted),
the Family and the Companions, people of courtesy, O Everlasting Who protected me from weariness.
O You Who give a knowledge whose steadfastness is a shield, bless the man of worth who upholds the Sunna,
his Family and his Companions, and grant peace, O You Who boast of me before the finest of the learned.
Bless with peace the Muqaddas (the Sanctified), the Muktafī, the Kāfī (the Sufficient) and the Spirit of holiness (Rūḥ al-Qudus),
the Family and the Companions devoted to worship, O You Who remove every lovesickness and distress.
Bless and grant peace, O Upholder of justice (Qurʾān 3:18), upon the imām of the messengers, Spirit of justice (Rūḥ al-Qisṭ),
his Family with all the Companions, O All-Embracing (Al-Wāsiʿ) Who made room for me with spaciousness.
Bless the Bāligh (the one who reached the goal), Spirit of truth (Rūḥ al-Ḥaqq), with a peace that leads to truth,
his Family and his Companions; and erase all that grieves me in my breast: You are the All-Hearing.
Bless the Muballigh (the Conveyor), the Mawṣūl (the Joined), the Wāṣil (the Arriver), the Healer, and increase my attainment.
And grant him peace with the illustrious Family and his Companions, and accept with thanks this composition through him.
And make obedience and charisma easy through him, and lead to the composer his aim.
O You Whose existence and beginningless eternity have appeared, bless him whose name is Muqaddam (the One Set Foremost),
Sāʾiq (the Driver onward) and Sābiq (the Forerunner), and grant peace, with his Family and his Companions, together with the learned.
(O) King, O Most Holy (Al-Quddūs), O Mighty (Al-ʿAzīz), bless him whose name is ʿAzīz (the Mighty),
and grant peace, and the Family and the Companions, O You Who spared me what brings lamentation.
O You Who spared me every aggressing evildoer, bless the most excellent rightly guided guide,
Fāḍil (the Excellent), and grant peace with the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
Bless and grant peace, O Opener (Al-Fattāḥ), upon him whose name is Miftāḥ (the Key),
his Family and his Companions; and show me what I wish in the two Abodes, without defilement.
Bless him whose name is Mufaḍḍal (the Preferred) and Fātiḥ (the Opener), with a peace that excels,
his Family and his Companions; and favour my whole being through the Select One, the Preferred.
Bless the Chosen One, the best of people, O best of those pleased by paronomasia,
the Family and the Companions, with peace, O Giver of nearness and (divine) converse.
Bless him who has been called Key of mercy, Key of Paradise, Remover of innovations,
and grant him peace with the noble Family and his Companions, O You Who boast of me before the refined.
Bless and grant peace, O Creator of the ages, upon the Prophet, Banner of faith (ʿAlam al-Īmān),
